positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Google Reliable Transport Team, Network Infrastructure.

positions.title: Systems Engineer (Intern)
positions.description:
● Created a service that periodically measures and stores latency measurements across all transit links between all pairs of Cloudflare points of presence. The results justified the benefits of controlling transit links rather than relying completely on BGP.

● Created a traceroute probe to verify that the mechanisms of transit selection were working correctly. This probe was optimized to discover paths as soon as possible, supported both IPv4 & IPv6, required no special privileges and used minimal resources on Cloudflare metals. It involved sending UDP packets and using the linux socket error queue.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Laying core infrastructure and designing all the in-house software abstractions keeping scalability and maintainability in mind.

● Designed and implemented "Peoplegraph" - a people search service that gathers and correlates online user profiles from multiple sources, built the pipeline for data gathering, storage and deduplication and put in place tools to aid in classification and machine learning.

● Designed and implemented a distributed crawling framework from scratch, composed of microservices coordinating through a message queue. The system has an easy to use DSL which makes it easy to describe what information needs to be captured and alerts users when it detects changes in site layouts, making it possible for a small team to manage hundreds of sources.

● Heavily optimized "Rqst" - a social media aggregation framework that tracked 200 million rss feeds in near real time, to work on an 8 node cluster. In addition, created an extensible enrichment component capable of tagging published articles with tags such as spam, duplicate and language.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enhanced the quality of entity recognition and improved the efficiency of the data pipeline.

● Parallelized an in-house named entity extractor to achieve a 400% speedup by making the process distribute load across multiple cores and machines.

● Restructured sequential sections of code in an in-house search and recommendation engine into modules that could benefit from pipeline parallelism.

● Helped move computation from private data centers to amazon EC2

____● Minimized cost using on-demand instances and restricting their lifetime to the duration of computation.

____● Parallelized computation that was previously restricted to one machine and leveraged the elastic nature of EC2 to autoscale computational resources based on observed load.

projects.title: Offloading Partial Network Function Computation to P4 Switches
projects.description: Designed a mechanism for the P4 switch to provide hints through packets to the Bro Intrusion Detection System and modified Bro to short circuit computation when hints were provided.

projects.title: "JIT Compatibility" Container Reuse in TEZ
projects.description: Explored the possibility of TEZ reusing a container with high percentage overlap of JIT compiled code and achieved an overall runtime reduction of 10-12% on short jobs with JIT-Compatible tasks.
